root_cause.text: An off-by-one validation error in the `titsc_config_wires` function of the `ti_am335x_tsc` driver uses a strict greater-than (`>`) comparison instead of greater-than-or-equal-to (`>=`) when checking `wire_order[i]` against `ARRAY_SIZE(config_pins)`, allowing an out-of-bounds index equal to the array size to bypass validation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the validation check in `drivers/input/touchscreen/ti_am335x_tsc.c` being corrected from `if (WARN_ON(wire_order[i] > ARRAY_SIZE(config_pins)))` to `if (WARN_ON(wire_order[i] >= ARRAY_SIZE(config_pins)))`.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `titsc_config_wires` introduced in this commit contains the off-by-one validation error. Specifically, on line 82, it checks `if (WARN_ON(wire_order[i] > ARRAY_SIZE(config_pins)))`. Since `ARRAY_SIZE(config_pins)` is 4, a `wire_order[i]` value of 4 will bypass this check because 4 is not strictly greater than 4. Later, on line 92, `bit_cfg = config_pins[wi_order];` is executed with `wi_order` equal to 4, causing an out-of-bounds array access.
